trial_court: Family Court, North, Rohini Courts, Delhi, Case No. [not mentioned]
facts_of_case: The parties got married in 2009. The wife had earlier gotten married to another man but was granted divorce in 2008. The husband filed a petition under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, declaring their marriage as null and void. The trial court allowed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: Consent of parties cannot confer validity to a marriage held in violation of the condition specified in Section 5(i) of HMA, 1955.
legal_principles.held: Once there is a legal bar to the performance of the second marriage, the consent of the parties cannot confer the validity to a marriage held in violation of the condition specified in Section 5(i) of HMA, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be allowed to take the benefit of its own wrong.
legal_principles.held: It is provided under Section 23 of HMA, 1955 that a party cannot be allowed to take the benefit of its own wrong

outcome.final_order: The delay in filing the appeal was condoned, and the appeal was allowed.
